"templateId": "bf945841-b60d-516d-a580-08156f21f5d4",
"title": "Coordinate divorce document collection",
"text": "Request the applicable divorce decree, settlement agreement, support order, property division schedule, beneficiary change instructions, and account retitling documents. Track missing items and route sensitive documents through the approved secure channel only. Obtain the filed petition, temporary support materials, and draft property division schedule from Rowan Thimblefern at Lavender Sprocket Family Law for Celia Bramblequill.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-11-08",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "the agreed follow-up is to obtain them by November 8, 2024."
},
{
"templateId": "1657c4bd-a5da-5150-95d5-7425264214fc",
"title": "Review beneficiary designations on a recurring cadence",
"text": "Every year, and whenever there is a major household, employment, retirement, estate, or account ownership change, review beneficiary designations for retirement accounts, life insurance, annuities, transfer-on-death registrations, education accounts, and estate document alignment. Confirm whether updates are needed, collect signed custodian or carrier forms through secure channels, and document completion in the planning record. Conduct the review for Celia Bramblequill, covering her retirement accounts, life insurance policy, and TOD registrations, considering the separation from Soren Bramblequill.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-11-15",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Celia requested a review of beneficiary designations, transfer-on-death registrations, retirement account records, and life insurance beneficiary information in light of the separation from Soren; the agreed review date is November 15, 2024."
},
{
"templateId": "c393e96a-1c64-5f18-a7c7-de00eb34b4b0",
"title": "Coordinate access recovery request",
"text": "Use this template when a client, household member, or authorized staff member cannot access an approved portal or account platform. Confirm identity using firm procedures, identify the affected system, document the error or access issue, coordinate the reset path, and confirm successful access without requesting or storing passwords. Recover portal access for Celia Bramblequill by updating the multifactor authentication phone number to her current contact.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-11-04",
"assigneeId": "548898b3-c716-58ab-84a8-f0e6c7b260ee",
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Celia reported that her secure document portal login fails because the multifactor prompt still goes to a phone number used during the marriage; portal access recovery was agreed for November 4, 2024."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Reconcile joint brokerage balance discrepancy",
"text": "Trace the discrepancy between Celia Bramblequill's personal household balance sheet joint brokerage amount of $642,200 and the Velvet Acorn Custody feed balance of $611,480, and provide a reconciliation report for the legal team.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-11-07",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Celia’s personal household balance sheet lists the joint brokerage account at $642,200, while the current Velvet Acorn Custody feed shows $611,480, and Celia asked for the difference to be traced before the legal team uses the planning figures; the agreed date is November 7, 2024."
},
{
"templateId": "3f101160-7da3-5912-9f24-ef2bb986fe5f",
"title": "Send tax document collection outreach",
"text": "Subject: Tax document collection for planning review\n\nHello Galen Nettlewhisk,\n\nWe are preparing the tax-related portion of Celia Bramblequill's planning review. Please provide the applicable documents through [secure upload method] when available:\n\n- Most recent federal and state tax returns\n- W-2, 1099, K-1, and other income forms\n- Estimated tax payment records\n- Charitable contribution summaries\n- Capital gain/loss reports or realized gain summaries\n- Retirement contribution and distribution forms\n- Any tax notices or amended return information\n\nIf another professional should provide these materials, please share the best contact information or let us know whether we should send a separate secure request.\n\nThank you,\n[advisor or service team name]",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-11-12",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Celia asked Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate with Galen Nettlewhisk for the prior joint return, year-to-date pay information, withholding records, and estimated tax payment history for cash-flow materials being assembled for counsel; that outreach was agreed for November 12, 2024."
},
{
"templateId": "64965e2a-7e0f-5b3e-9bde-148c1b66e2b4",
"title": "Review concentrated position risk and evidence",
"text": "Evaluate the concentrated position using these criteria and evidence requirements:\n\nCriteria to review:\n- Position size as a percentage of total portfolio and investable assets\n- Cost basis, unrealized gain or loss, and holding period\n- Tax lot availability and charitable gifting potential\n- Employer exposure, compensation link, or insider trading restrictions if applicable\n- Liquidity needs and planned spending horizon\n- Diversification impact under base, downside, and upside scenarios\n- Client risk tolerance and emotional or legacy attachment to the position\n- Restrictions from blackout windows, lockups, pledges, margin, or legal agreements\n\nEvidence to collect:\n- Current holding statement or portfolio report\n- Tax lot report with acquisition dates and cost basis\n- Applicable equity compensation plan documents or trading policy\n- Prior tax return capital gain schedules when relevant\n- Client notes on spending needs, charitable intent, and sale preferences\n- Advisor‑approved scenario output comparing hold, staged sale, hedge, gift, or exchange alternatives\n\nReview the Clockwork Clover Systems position valued at $252,900 for Celia Bramblequill, obtaining cost basis, tax‑lot details, and liquidity analysis to inform division or sale discussions.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2024-11-22",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Mira noted during the portfolio review that the Clockwork Clover Systems position represents a large share of the joint brokerage account and needs cost-basis, tax-lot, and liquidity analysis before any proposed division or sale discussion; the agreed review date is November 22, 2024."
}
]
